name: borrifo-lab
description: Laboratório de Atividades — jogo de arena e tinta (Borrifo). Projeto separado do Trivo principal.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client,shell -c magenta,cyan,yellow "pnpm --filter @borrifo/game-server dev" "pnpm --filter @borrifo/game-client dev" "pnpm --filter @borrifo/activity-shell dev"
scripts.e2e: node e2e/shell.mjs && node e2e/gameplay.mjs && node e2e/gamepad.mjs && node e2e/tutorial.mjs
